card.name: Disclaimer and reporting-line wording
card.fires_on: Words inside stock disclaimer and side-effect reporting sentences, such as the period after 'side effects', 'is' after 'information provided', and 'not' in 'for information purposes only'. Also partway through citation names like Merck and Curr Opin.

modes.label: Disclaimer phrasing
modes.description: Linking words in 'information provided is intended' or 'for information purposes only and not'.
modes.example: The material presented on this site is provided for information purposes only<< and>> not for medical purposes.

modes.label: Side-effect reporting line
modes.description: The period after 'Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects', before the FDA reporting sentence.
modes.example: Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects<<.>> You may report side effects to FDA at

modes.label: Citation names
modes.description: Middle of 'Merck' or 'Curr Opin' in reference lists.
modes.example: Whitehouse Station, NJ: Mer<<ck>> Research Laboratories; 1999

card.plain: It marks stock legal and reporting phrases, like disclaimers and the 'report side effects to FDA' line, where the next words are highly predictable.
